answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 23 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. The ripple register is checked at draw time, horizon lists the eligible set, and prism seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 23 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an copycat pays for every seat it wants. Honest users pay that once, farms 25 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
